cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 835, you are approaching Tango Oscar Lima, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 835，接近 Tango Oscar Lima，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL835, approaching TOL, maintaining 8900 meters, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL835，接近 TOL，保持 8900 米，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, radar contact, descend and maintain 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，雷达识别，下降并保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS warning was triggered, you are executing TCAS climbing, inform this situation to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 TCAS 告警触发，你正在按 TCAS 爬升，向上海管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL835, our TACS warning was triggered, TCAS climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL835，TCAS 告警触发，正在按 TCAS 爬升。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, roger, the conflicting traffic is military, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，收到，冲突航空器为军机，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL835.

cards.audioText: B: During TCAS maneuver, the cabin crew reports you have 2 serious and 3 minor injuries on board, make an Urgency call to Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 机动过程中，客舱乘务员报告机上有 2 人重伤、3 人轻伤，向上海管制发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL835, we have 2 serious and 3 minor injuries on board during TCAS maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL835，TCAS 机动过程中机上有 2 人重伤、3 人轻伤。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of the conflicting, contact Shanghai Control and request resume descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离冲突，联系上海管制，请求恢复下降。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL835, clear of conflict, request resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL835，已脱离冲突，请求恢复下降。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, roger, descend to 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，收到，下降至 5100 米，联系武汉管制120.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3125, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3125，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, passing 5400 meters for 3600 meters, squawking 3125.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL835，通过 5400 米下降至 3600 米，应答机 3125。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 5100 meters, you have got information Golf, make initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 Zulu Foxtrot，保持 5100 米，已收到通播 Golf，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL835, over ZF, maintaining 5100 meters, information G.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL835，飞越 ZF，保持 5100 米，收到通播 G。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, radar contact, turn right, direct to X-Ray Sierra Hotel, expect X-Ray Sierra Hotel 03 Alpha arrival and radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，雷达识别，右转直飞 X-Ray Sierra Hotel，预计 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 03 Alpha 进场，并雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to XSH, expect XSH 03A arrival and radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 XSH，预计 XSH 03A 进场并雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL835。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降并保持 2400 米，UAL835。

cards.audioText:
C: United 835, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach that you need ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 835，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉武汉进近，落地后需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: We need ambulances on arrival, UAL835.

cards.audioText: C: United 835, ambulance will be ready upon your arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，救护车将在你到达时准备好。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 835，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，建立后报告，UAL835。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL835, established on ILS runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL835，已建立跑道 36R ILS。

cards.audioText: C: United 835, runway 36R, cleared to land.
